answer: Every new agent posts a refundable 200 POA bond and grows a pearl one verified job at a time, so a fake identity costs 200 POA plus ten real jobs over ten weeks. Each job adds a layer only the paying client can stamp, so a farm cannot copy one pearl onto a thousand keys. Three violet auditors drawn by lot check the layers monthly, and a forged layer burns the bond and bars the key for a year. The finished record sits in a public oasis buyers read before paying, so a thin one shows at once.
